VAL-SETUP-011.observed: Editor loaded at floor_plan_version 11. Drag of G4-1 from (100,100) plus one added wall element produced a dirty draft ('Unsaved draft changes' badge, live-region announcement) while SQLite stayed identical: rsv_tables G4-1 still (100,100), 0 rows in rsv_floor_elements for G4-Area, floor_plan_version still 11, floor_plan.save audit count unchanged (4). Reload without saving discarded the draft: the page rendered G4-1 back at (100,100) with 0 elements and no unsaved badge; SQLite still unchanged. 'Leave without saving' -> confirm banner ('You have unsaved floor plan changes. Leave and discard your local draft?') -> 'Discard & leave' navigated to /acme/reservations/settings/tables with SQLite unchanged. An explicit Save then sent PUT /operator/reservations/setup/locations/<id>/floor-plan with expectedFloorPlanVersion 11, returned HTTP 200, and the same request's follow-up GET returned 200; the editor showed 'Floor plan saved (v12).'; rsv_location_settings.floor_plan_version incremented 11 -> 12 and rsv_audit_log gained one row (action='floor_plan.save', entity_type='floor_plan', entity_id=v17plv08r5v357bie335lyq8, at=1792193281786). Two further saves behaved the same (v13, v14, v15, v16).
VAL-SETUP-011.notes: Owned fixture: G4-Area + G4-1/G4-2 were created before the UI work via POST /operator/reservations/setup/areas and /tables with a minted setup token (the editor itself has no 'Add area' control). The known non-blocking quirk (post-save follow-up GET failing and showing 'Failed to save floor plan.') did not occur in any of the six saves in this group. Console: no page errors, no console errors or warnings.

VAL-SETUP-012.observed: curl PUT /operator/reservations/setup/locations/<id>/floor-plan with expectedFloorPlanVersion 15 while the live value was 16 returned HTTP 409 {"error":"stale_version","message":"Floor plan has been modified by another session; reload before saving.","floorPlanVersion":16,"currentFloorPlanVersion":16}; read-only sqlite before and after showed identical rows (G4-1 500/290/90/90/45 although the payload asked for x=510; G4-Wall x=60 although the payload asked for x=430; version still 16). In the editor: loaded at v16, a save by 'another operator' (valid curl PUT with expectedFloorPlanVersion 16) bumped the version to 17 and moved G4-2 x 310 -> 320; a 1-unit keyboard nudge (draft x=501) plus Save then produced PUT 409 (captured in HAR) and the editor rendered role="alert" data-testid=floor-plan-conflict-banner: 'Stale floor plan version (409 conflict): another operator saved changes since you opened this floor plan. Reload the latest floor plan or inspect your draft before re-applying.' with a 'Reload latest floor plan' button. SQLite after the UI 409 was unchanged by the editor (G4-1 still 500/290); the banner's Reload action then loaded v17 and cleared the conflict, showing G4-2 at (320,110).
VAL-SETUP-012.notes: The concurrent save came from my own curl request because the contract simulates 'another operator'; both the 409 body and the UI banner were produced by the real tenant-api and the real editor.

VAL-SETUP-013.observed: Grid size observed: 10 canvas units (FLOOR_GRID_STEP=10; UI copy 'Drag tables on the 10-unit grid'). A drag whose raw pointer delta would have placed G4-1 at (497,293) landed at exactly (500,290) in the DOM/inspector, i.e. x and y snapped to the 10-unit grid. Dragging the resize handle by (+23,+17) changed the drawn size to exactly 90x90 (73 -> 90, 87 -> 90). Setting the inspector rotation to 45 produced transform rotate(45deg). Save returned PUT 200 with the follow-up GET 200 ('Floor plan saved (v12).'); rsv_tables G4-1 became x=500 y=290 w=90 h=90 rotation=45 and GET /floor-plan returned the same values after reload; the reloaded editor rendered style left=500px top=290px width=90px height=90px transform=rotate(45deg).
VAL-SETUP-013.notes: The observed snap step is 10 units for drag and resize; the resize handle only exists while the item is selected. Console: no errors.

VAL-SETUP-014.observed: With G4-2 selected and the table focused: ArrowRight 300 -> 301, ArrowDown 100 -> 101, ArrowLeft 301 -> 300, ArrowUp 101 -> 100 (1 canvas unit per keypress); Shift+ArrowRight 300 -> 310 and Shift+ArrowDown 100 -> 110 (10 canvas units). Save returned 200 ('Floor plan saved (v13).') and rsv_tables shows G4-2 x=310 y=110; GET /floor-plan returns the same.
VAL-SETUP-014.notes: Later, the VAL-SETUP-012 concurrent-save simulation moved G4-2 x 310 -> 320 on purpose (that write is part of 012, not a nudge failure).

VAL-SETUP-015.observed: Added one decor element per supported kind inside G4-Area using the 'Decor element type' select + 'Add element' button, then positioned/labelled/resized/rotated them in the Element Inspector: wall G4-Wall (60,20 160x20), bar G4-Bar (60,60 160x60), door G4-Door (260,20 60x20 rotate 90 via the 90-degree preset), window G4-Window (260,60 120x20), label G4-Label (400,20 120x40), plant G4-Plant (420,80 40x40), zone G4-Zone (60,180, resized to 240x180). Save -> 200 'Floor plan saved (v14).'; rsv_floor_elements holds exactly 7 rows for the area with distinct kinds bar,door,label,plant,wall,window,zone, and rsv_tables for G4-Area still contains only G4-1,G4-2 (no bookable tables created). friction.description: The App renders a 6px fixed navigation progress bar (div.fixed.inset-x-0.top-0.z-50) at the top of the viewport. When the editor's 'Save floor plan' button sat in that strip, agent-browser clicks failed with 'covered by <div.fixed.inset-x-0>' and the save silently did not happen (the draft stayed dirty) until the button was scrolled into view.
friction.resolution: Scroll the save control into view (scrollIntoView block:'center') before clicking; then the PUT fired normally. Not documented in user-testing.md.

friction.description: The floor plane editor offers no 'Add dining area' control, so an isolated area for geometry/element work has to be created outside the editor first.
friction.resolution: Created G4-Area and its two tables through POST /operator/reservations/setup/areas and /tables with a minted setup token before doing all editor work inside that area.

friction.description: The first load of the floor-plan route was fast (no 30-66 s compile), but every navigation resets the selected dining area to the first tab, so evidence capture needs a click on the G4-Area tab after each reload.
friction.resolution: Clicked the area tab after each reload before reading DOM state.
